claim.value: Queue wait, worker execution, object-read and upload durations should be separated only when trace semantics permit that separation.
claim.scope: A restriction on phase decomposition; separability and additivity are not assumed.

provenance.rationale: P007 identifies the phases and explicitly conditions their separation on trace semantics, without asserting additivity.

signal_basis.value: The operation restricts phase decomposition to what trace semantics permit. The proposed phase signal uses ordinary queue waits followed by prolonged reads or uploads only when those phases are measured comparably; overlapping spans and timing inconsistencies can distort comparisons.
signal_basis.scope: Interpretability of trace-derived phase durations and comparisons, without assuming independent or additive measurements.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the decomposition restriction, the comparability-qualified signal, and the measurement limitations.
The claim is supported as a methodological restriction and requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Meaningful phase comparisons require trace timestamps and spans to support the intended interpretation. The claim licenses decomposition only under that condition and makes no stronger assertion about separability or additivity.
uncertainty: Whether particular traces permit decomposition is execution-specific; under the stipulated prerequisites, it does not undermine this restriction.
